envelope.description: Verify protected candidate origin and archive retrieval

body.title: Verify protected candidate origin and archive retrieval
body.summary: Implement protected fetch validation against trusted repository IDs, workflow, event, run/attempt, ref, SHA, target, artifact and expiry before reading only bounded allowed output entries. Reject duplicate and foreign assets.
acceptanceChecks: Same-version Darwin and Linux outputs remain independently addressable. Rerun, workflow, fork, ID, target and transport/inner digest mismatches fail closed.
Validate inputs and extract only named bounded members, with directory and archive safety retained.
Verify authenticated artifact transport SHA-256 or an independently recorded protected expected inner SHA-256. Candidate metadata never supplies its own trust anchor.

tests.name: GitHub origin and validated download fixtures for Linux, Darwin, rerun, substituted origin, duplicate ZIP members and digest tampering
